topic: How does full frequency reuse impact inter-beam interference margins in link budget calculations for high SE systems?
consensus_response: Full frequency reuse (FFR) increases inter-beam interference (IBI), moving the link budget from power-limited to interference-limited, affecting users at beam edges. This reduces spectral efficiency and capacity per beam. Advanced techniques like precoding or multi-user detection can mitigate IBI, but add complexity and power consumption. Adaptive Beamforming can also dynamically adjust antenna patterns to reduce IBI. FFR's increased IBI margin comes at a cost: reduced spectral efficiency and capacity per beam.
